spans.s: गुच्छ m. 1. A bundle, a bunch; 2. a bunch of flowers, a cluster of blossoms, ववुरयुक्छदगुच्छसुगंधयः Sis.vi.50; 3. the plumage of a peacock; 4. necklace of pearls in general; 5. a pearl necklace of 32 (or according to some, of 70) strings.
गुच्छ-अर्ध (I) m. a pearl necklace of 24 strings.
गुच्छ-अर्ध (II) m.n. half of a cluster.
गुच्छ-कणिश m. a kind of corn.
गुच्छक m. The same as गुच्छ q.v.
